reason: I've never heard of TROVE and it's brand new on 1 November, so I'm not putting my card details into it straight away. If I want to go to a comedy show I'll just book with the host or a site I already know and skip the extra R8.
objection: Is my money actually safe with an app nobody I know has used yet? The TradeSafe escrow sounds good, but I'd still worry about getting stuck without a refund. And I don't like that the R8 isn't refunded if I cancel.
would_change_my_mind: Friends using it with no problems, or a first booking with no booking fee, for an event I already wanted to go to that's cheaper or only available on TROVE.
